name: finite-and-legacy-tests
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bun test core/sized-sort.test.ts kernel/kernel.test.ts kernel/sets.test.ts core/compile.test.ts core/keyterms.test.ts core/quantifiers.test.ts core/pairs.test.ts core/runtime-keys.test.ts core/count-cases.test.ts core/request-quotient.test.ts lean-kernel/export-shape.test.ts lean-kernel/qalpha.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1

name: package-typecheck
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit --declaration false > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/typecheck.log" 2>&1
